name: Silver Crane Wing (Combat)
body:
Your sacrifice to others grants you divine protection.

Prerequisites: Silver Crane Style, Silver Crane Feathers, Perception 11 ranks.

Benefit: When you use your Silver Crane Feathers feat you can make a Will save (DC equal to the ability damage dealt + the hit point damage dealt). If you succeed, the damage is negated rather than being redirected to you.
